principle: The substrate changes the authority answer, never the vocabulary. The same mechanical axis (cascade and session coupling) that decides the P08 mount profile decides which edits are possible on it.

rules.denial_constraint: content lives behind the service boundary; no host-side seam addresses it
rules.nearest_alternative: edit the host-side label or heading surrounding the pane

rules.denial_constraint: CSS custom properties do not inherit across a cross-origin iframe boundary
rules.nearest_alternative: re-mount as absorbed_native (P08 cost band: ~273 lines / 9 files) or accept donor-default styling within the pane
rules.note: The cell clients push hardest on: looks trivially easy, is mechanically impossible. Refusal quality matters most here.
rules.cross_lane_edge: S2-L2 owns token values and the donor-token binding schema; S2-L3 owns this operation that writes them

rules.escalation_condition: slot is order-dependent — reordering changes meaning, not presentation

rules.control_point: the insertion point, not the inserted thing — a slot that does not enumerate permitted capabilities cannot accept an add

rules.requires: inverse recorded for undo; orphaned bindings reported, never silently dropped
rules.built_receipt: data-siso-hide=settings/footer attributes plus CSS injected only when framed (teable-siso-absorption.patch:175,188,201,234-248)

rules.escalation_reason: replacing a donor changes the composition member set, and therefore its scope intersection, rights state, runtime profile and rollback surface — a composition act, not an edit
rules.solver_requirement: candidates filtered for port compatibility BEFORE the client is shown a choice

rules.constraint: C2 — may only target resources already in the release's declared scope; scope is the intersection of member scopes, never the union
rules.category_error_warning: routinely presented in market UIs with the same weight as a style change; it is the only verb that can alter what data the application touches
rules.denial_constraint: the service owns its own data layer behind the boundary; no host-side seam can rebind it, and a host-side rebind would place the service outside the release's declared scope (C2)
rules.nearest_alternative: bind the host-side surface that surrounds the pane, or escalate to a composition change that re-declares the module's scope with its rights and runtime consequences priced

channel_rule.statement: A bounded editor is only as bounded as its least-bounded channel. Every channel — visual editor, chat, agent, direct API write, migration, upgrade — resolves through this same authority table, or the table is decorative.
channel_rule.evidence: Lovable has the best observed binding (compile-time stable component IDs, line-scoped diffs) and an ungated escape hatch that dissolves the composition anyway.
